item.name: Creates a new account with the partner account as the parent account and also creates all domains provided in the request body as enabled domains linked to the account that was created.

request.name: Creates a new account with the partner account as the parent account and also creates all domains provided in the request body as enabled domains linked to the account that was created.

description.content:
Optional:
- org-domain-name (the list of the domains that will be associated with the account)
- enabled-org-domains-limit (the limit of enabled domains)
- blocked-org-domains-limit (the limit of blocked domains)
- sending-sub-domains-limit (the limit of domains with sender services)
- approved-senders-limit (the limit of approved senders)
- package-slug (if it is not provided, the account will be created with the default package Valimail Core, subject to partner package permissions. To get the package-slug, please use [GET]/accounts/packages endpoint)
Required:
- name (the name of the account. It also is the base for the account slug to be created)

Response notes:
- empty or null fields are omitted from the response payload
- numeric limit fields are serialized as strings in the response payload

response.name: OK - Account created. Response fields are omitted when the value is empty or null, and numeric limit fields are returned as strings.
